verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an official CLI and a REST API (/v1 endpoints) for building CI systems and agent workflows. It never mentions an official client SDK or library in any language, and a raw REST API is an adjacent building block, not an SDK. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404 on all paths, so there is no evidence of a generated client either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
